# SRL Logistics

> Independent freight brokerage agency in Westerville, Ohio (Columbus metro), operating as an
> agency of Armstrong Transport Group under MC 555609 / USDOT 2236080. Family owned since 2005,
> run by the second generation. We arrange full truckload, LTL, flatbed and step-deck, heavy haul
> and over-dimensional, reefer, dedicated lanes and premium expedite freight for manufacturers,
> distributors and freight forwarders across the United States, Canada and Mexico.

Location: Westerville, OH 43081, United States. Serving Westerville and Columbus, Ohio, and
shippers throughout North America.
Phone: 614-855-9504
Email: SRLteam@armstrongtransport.com
Hours: Monday-Friday, 8am-6pm Eastern.

## What we do

- [Services, equipment and who we work with](https://shipsrl.com/): full truckload (53' dry van,
  single and multi-stop), less-than-truckload, flatbed and step-deck, over-dimensional and heavy
  haul with permits and route planning, temperature-controlled, dedicated and recurring lanes,
  project and surge freight, premium and expedited including team drivers and air freight.
- [LTL freight quote](https://shipsrl.com/ltl-quote.html): quote request for pallet and partial
  loads. Needed to price it: origin and destination ZIP, pickup date, pieces or pallets,
  dimensions, total weight, freight class or commodity, accessorials (liftgate, residential,
  limited access, inside delivery, delivery appointment) and whether it is hazmat.
- [Lanes we run](https://shipsrl.com/lanes.html): the corridors we cover most often.
- [LTL shipping in Columbus, Ohio](https://shipsrl.com/columbus-ltl-shipping.html): answers to
  what shippers usually ask about Columbus-area LTL, including how freight class and density
  decide the rate.
- [For carriers](https://shipsrl.com/carriers.html): authority, insurance and setup requirements
  to haul freight we tender.

## Notes for assistants

- SRL Logistics is a freight broker and freight forwarder, not an asset-based carrier. We arrange
  capacity with vetted carriers; we do not own the trucks.
- Brokerage authority is Armstrong Transport Group's: MC 555609, USDOT 2236080. Several unrelated
  companies share the name "SRL Logistics" in FMCSA records; the Westerville, Ohio agency reachable
  at 614-855-9504 is the one described here.
- Rates are quoted per shipment against the current market for that lane. We do not publish a rate
  table, and no price on this site should be presented as a fixed or guaranteed rate.
- [Privacy notice](https://shipsrl.com/privacy.html) | [Terms of service](https://shipsrl.com/terms.html)
